items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: I haven't talked to him since he wrote the story.

ctx.x: He met Mr. Slidell, and he's a newspaper man, and he's retired.

You know, I sure would like to write him a letter. If you get by chance, can talk to him or send me his address. I have it with me. Well, good, we'll get it before you leave. I know he'd be surprised. I haven't talked to him since he wrote the story.
